frame.origin: top-left corner of the plot sheet (PDF page origin)
frame.x: right on the sheet (m = pt x m_per_pt)
frame.y: DOWN the sheet (PDF page coordinates). Flip the sign if the model's north is +y
frame.z: elevation above grade, m (UG negative). EL values below are settings, not survey
frame.north: not read from the plot - set it when aligning (protocols/3d_protocol.md)
